build_autoencoder_kl_hunyuanimage: build a HunyuanImage VAE autoencoder model with configurable latent channels and spatial compression ratio
encode_images_with_autoencoder: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the AutoencoderKLHunyuanImage encoder
decode_latents_with_autoencoder: decode latent vectors back to pixel space images using the AutoencoderKLHunyuanImage decoder
enable_tiled_vae_processing: enable spatial tiled encoding and decoding for large images to reduce memory usage
run_forward_pass_autoencoder: run a full encode-decode forward pass through the AutoencoderKLHunyuanImage model with posterior sampling
